description: A tiny 2014 McDonald's Happy Meal Penny Ling panda, the kind of thing that ends up in a junk drawer for a decade before someone finally lets it go. No box, some light scuffing from a life well-loved by a small child, but her sparkly eyes are all there. Good for a collector, a diorama, or a kid who just wants a panda.
pickNote: Found this little guy while cleaning out a donation box and couldn't say no to that face.

name: 2009 McDonald's Littlest Pet Shop Monkey Toy
description: A tiny plastic monkey with the big glassy eyes that made this whole toy line weirdly irresistible, straight from a 2009 Happy Meal. Some light surface scuffing from a life spent in a toy bin, but the paint and details are intact and it's still got that little bit of charm. No box, just the monkey, ready for its next kid or collector.
pickNote: I found this guy loose in a drawer of random treasures and honestly could not put him back down.

name: Littlest Pet Shop Squirrel Bobblehead Toy
description: A little 2011 McDonald's Happy Meal find from the Littlest Pet Shop line, complete with a bobbling squirrel head that nods along to nothing in particular. Expect light shelf wear and maybe a scuff or two from a past life in some kid's toy bin, but the bobble action still works great. Not a clothing item, but too charming to leave out of the shop.
pickNote: I have a weakness for tiny bobbleheads with more personality than they have any right to — this squirrel earned his spot on the counter.

name: 2015 McDonald's Littlest Pet Shop Purple Squirrel Toy
description: A little purple squirrel named Carla Decourant, plucked from a Happy Meal back in 2015 and somehow still looking pretty pleased with herself. Expect minor scuffs from being loved (or chewed) by a kid, but no cracks or missing pieces. A tiny bit of nostalgia for the LPS collector or the person who just wants a weird purple squirrel on their shelf.
pickNote: Carla's been sitting in my 'weird treasures' box for way too long and honestly, she deserves a home.

name: Rainbow High Red-Haired Fashion Doll
description: This is a Rainbow High doll shop, not clothes shop, but Jojin couldn't resist featuring her anyway. Red sequined skirt, matching ankle boots, and hair that took me way too long to detangle for photos. A couple loose hair strands and minor styling wear, but face paint and outfit are clean and vibrant.
pickNote: Not gonna lie, I spent way too long detangling her hair for the photos, but that red sequined skirt was worth the effort. She's ready for her close-up.

name: Rainbow High Winter Wonderland Violet Willow Doll
description: Violet Willow shows up in her icy winter look with that signature purple hair ready to hold a pose or a grudge. No original photo to prove condition, so assume some played-with love (loose joints, maybe a stray marker mark) until you unbox her yourself. A fun grab for collectors or a kid who's into fashion dolls with attitude.
pickNote: Grabbed this one for the purple hair alone — she's giving 'too cool for the snow' energy.

name: Blue-Haired Fashion Doll In Denim Layers
description: This Rainbow High doll comes fully committed to head-to-toe denim, from the cropped jacket down to the metallic little booties. Her hair has some flyaways and tangling from a previous life on someone's shelf, and the outfit shows a few loose threads if you look closely, but she's otherwise intact and ready for her next photoshoot.
pickNote: Not a doll person myself, but even I have to admit her denim-on-denim game is stronger than mine.

name: Rainbow High Grayscale Fashion Doll in Plaid Skirt
description: A moody monochrome Rainbow High doll with silvery curls, a plaid mini skirt, and tiny buckled boots that somehow still stand up straight. Full range of joint articulation works fine, hair has a little frizz from being loved, and the corset piece is a touch loose but stays put. Comes as pictured, no box.
pickNote: This one's giving 'goth it girl who still does her homework,' and I'm obsessed with the tiny boots.

name: Rainbow High Vivienne Rouge Doll
description: Vivienne Rouge in her signature red look, ready to hold court on someone's shelf or reroute to the dress-up bin. No box, and there may be a bit of shelf-wear or flyaway hair from a previous life, so give her a quick brush before her debut.
pickNote: This doll walked so my inner child could run, straight to the checkout counter.

name: Purple-Haired Rainbow High Doll With Iridescent Dress
description: A big-eyed Rainbow High doll in her original purple ruffled dress with a shimmery pink underlay and matching boots. Her hair is soft and full with a fun rainbow streak, though the display box shows some shelf wear from being handled by curious little hands. A fun grab for collectors or anyone building a doll wardrobe on a budget.
pickNote: This one's got main character energy and I kind of want to keep her, but she's ready for a new home.

name: Shadow High Nicole Steel Doll
description: A striking Shadow High fashion doll with signature gray skin and a wild mane of silver curls, ready for her next closet cameo. Previously loved, so expect some minor play wear and maybe a slightly ambitious hairstyle from a past owner, but she's still got plenty of runway attitude left in her.
pickNote: Nicole showed up looking so dramatic I had to bring her home, even though I have zero business buying dolls for a clothing shop.

name: Rainbow High Fashion Doll With Graphic Tee Set
description: A big-eyed Rainbow High doll in her original tee and distressed white shorts, hair a little windswept from storage but otherwise sweet and displayable. Comes in a clear box for easy shelf styling, though it's a repurposed case rather than the original packaging. Great for a collector or a kid who likes her toys with attitude.
pickNote: Found her tucked in with the plushies and couldn't resist those dramatic lashes — she's ready for her next home.

name: Rainbow High Fashion Doll With Sunset Hair
description: A fiery-haired Rainbow High doll still boxed up, rocking a two-piece graffiti-print outfit that spells out her own hype. Box shows a little shelf wear and the plastic's slightly warped from sitting near other treasures, but the doll herself is untouched and camera-ready. Great for a collector or a kid who wants glam right out of the gate.
pickNote: Found her holding court next to my Magic cards and couldn't resist giving this one a little shelf of her own.

name: Rainbow High Doll With Mint Denim Set
description: This mint-haired fashionista comes fully decked out in her cropped denim jacket, matching jeans, and gold hoop earrings, still displayed in her plastic case. Hair is a little wind-blown from handling and there's some loose fuzz around the edges, but her face paint and outfit are clean and bright. A solid pick for a collector or a kid who takes her toy styling seriously.
pickNote: This one's been posing on my shelf all week and honestly I get it, she's got main character energy.

name: Ghost-Pale Fashion Doll in Mint Floral Dress
description: A porcelain-pale doll with silvery hair, purple lips, and a mint tulle dress covered in tiny flowers, still bagged from her last home. She's got that big-eyed, slightly haunted glamour look down perfectly, no missing pieces that we can see through the plastic. Bag has some creasing and a bit of marker writing on it, doll herself appears unplayed with.
pickNote: This one's giving quiet mall-goth fairy energy and I am obsessed.

name: Green-Haired Rainbow High Doll
description: A collectible fashion doll with a wild mane of lime green curls and a matching Rainbow-branded athleisure fit, hoodie, skirt, and all. Still in its plastic packaging so the outfit's crisp, but the box itself didn't survive the move to the shop floor. A fun find for doll collectors or a kid who takes their color coordination seriously.
pickNote: This one's got more personality in her eyebrows than most people I know.

name: Rainbow High Doll With Sequin Dress
description: A lavender-haired Rainbow High doll in her sparkly sequin mini dress, fully poseable and ready for a new shelf to call home. Her hair has some flyaways and static clinginess from being boxed up, and there's a little plastic wrap residue on her face that should wipe off, but the sequins and joints are all intact. A fun grab for a collector or a kid who loves a dramatic wardrobe.
pickNote: Found her tucked in a box of dolls and could not resist that hair, even a little wild, she's got main character energy.

name: Rainbow High Doll With Teal & Purple Hair

name: Pink Bratz Fur-Trim Boot Shoes
description: A loose pair of pink Bratz doll boots with that little furry trim molded right into the plastic, no box, no dolls, just the shoes. Great for collectors piecing together an outfit or crafters who need doll-scale accessories. Minor shelf wear from display but otherwise solid.
